title: XSS flaw in ansi2html.py allowed SourceHut account takeover via build logs
content_md:
An XSS flaw in ansi2html.py allowed SourceHut account takeover via build logs. The vector is elegant: data injected into build output is interpreted as HTML.

via Mastodon https://blog.arusekk.pl/posts/srht-account-takeover/
exclude_reason: French Mastodon repost of the arusekk.pl SourceHut article already covered by the existing SourceHut story.
